title: Too many ads
body: I have to x out of 3 ads every time I open it which has subconsciously stopped me from opening it. I won’t pay money to make me more open to using an app.
author: JamesCyr

title: Love it
body: This app works so well and I feel so happy that I stumbled across it. It has really helped me reach my daily goals in lots of things. I’ve even found myself taking the dog out for a walk late at night to make sure I get 100% in everything. It’s simple but clever and really well designed.
author: paddycomyn
